name: NarcoScope
headline: Drug-market records you can inspect, cite, and challenge.
description: NarcoScope translates hard-to-read official drug-market records into maps, comparisons, plain-language explanations, and deterministic evidence analyses without turning administrative data into claims it cannot support.
use_cases: Compare official retail-price, seizure, mortality, wastewater, and designation records.
Read newsroom analyses with sentence-level citations, correction history, and explicit abstentions.
Import a public aggregate China record into an evidence workflow through the Palimpsest bridge.
Give an AI agent read-only access to bounded, source-linked artifacts through MCP or OpenAPI.
proof: Every newsroom sentence and data row is citation-gated before publication.
Official, illustrative, stale, unavailable, and capability-only inputs stay visibly distinct.
Machine briefs, cited dossiers, JSON Feed, Atom, OpenAPI, and MCP resolve to the same published artifacts.
boundaries: No point-of-sale, real-time, sub-street, or navigable location information.
No precursor synthesis routes, chemistry, or yields.
Seizure changes are not treated as trafficking-volume changes without independent modalities.
A designation or reported origin is not an adjudication of guilt or causal proof.
